newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi Sec says to cooperate with investigators.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi Sec says to cooperate with investigators.

text.p: Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it would cooperate with the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission and prosecutors in their investigation into the brokerage's alleged violation of the Japanese securities laws.
"We solemnly accept the situation and truly regret the trouble we have caused our customers and others," Yamaichi said in a statement.
On Wednesday official of the securities watchdog and prosecutors raided Yamaichi offices searching for evidence of suspected illegal stock deals.
Prosecutors said they suspected that Yamaichi, one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages, paid 79 million yen to a "sokaiya" racketeer.
Media reports said the money was paid to the racketeer Ryichi Koike in 1995 to reimburse him for losses incurred through illegal discretionary trading.
Koike has been indicted by prosecutors in a scandal embroiling Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd.
